activity_summary: That night you put a small cross beside the fifth in the almanac and wrote no word next to it. The leaf does not say whose window it was. You do not know.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Made the cross and did not gloss it.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Mentioned in A cross and no word

facets.activity: Marked the fifth with a cross
